programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri has plenty of deals to welcome four chefs to Flavortown Market, with red light specials in all 10 aisles; using the red light specials, the chefs must create a fried feast before making a pork dish that's limited to 11 ingredients or fewer.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri invites some of the newest chefs from "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" to compete in Flavortown Market, where they make their bestseller; the chefs roll the GGG dice to see what mandatory items they must use in an elevated comfort classic.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Alex Guarnaschelli makes her return to Flavortown Market by taking on Rocco DiSpirito and Brian Malarkey; Guy Fieri hits them with his new swap wheel.

programs.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programs.desc: Guy Fieri welcomes opponents who previously tied as they return for tiebreaker rematches; two home cooks fight for their right to make the best party plate, and two supermoms compete in a budget battle to make the most comforting comfort food.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri kicks off Game Day as the reigning champ faces Torrence Chef T Gregoire and Joe Flamm in tackling fan-favorite flavors; judges Marcel Vigneron and Marcus Samuelsson are calling the plays and only one chef can win up to $20,000.

programs.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programs.desc: Guy Fieri has declared it Fry Day, and the returning champion takes on Jacob Town and Taylor Frankel in an epic battle for golden brown and delicious domination; Judges Mei Lin and Maneet Chauhan decide which chef takes home the gold and up to $20,000.
